title: Vocational Education and Careers
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 8 (Pathways to Progress) عن التعليم الفني والمهارات وسوق العمل، بالمعنى الإنجليزي والعربي وأمثلة وتدريبات زي Review D.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the **key vocabulary of Unit 8: Pathways to Progress**. Each word has a simple English meaning, the Arabic meaning and a short example. Then you will practise word families, collocations, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms.

blocks.text: الصفحة دي فيها **أهم كلمات Unit 8: Pathways to Progress**، متقسمة حسب دروس الوحدة. الوحدة بتتكلم عن **التعليم الفني (vocational education)** وإزاي بيدّي الطالب **مهارات عملية (practical skills)** تساعده يلاقي شغل، وعن **المهارات اللي أصحاب الشغل عايزينها (employability skills)** زي التواصل والعمل في فريق، وإزاي ده بيخدم **تنمية مصر الاقتصادية**.

الكلمات دي متاخدة من نصوص الوحدة وجداول الـ **Vocabulary** و**Media Analysis: Key Concepts** في الكتاب: **8.1 Vocational Education in Egypt** (تسجيل عمر)، **8.2 Vocational Voices** (مؤتمر الشباب: أحمد وجوليا ويوسف ونادية وديميتري)، **8.3 The Egyptian-Japanese Schools (EJS)** (التوكاتسو ووقت التنضيف)، **8.4 The Skills Employers Really Want** (From School to Work)، وكمان **Consolidation Review D**.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات صح؟

text: Do not learn a word alone. Learn its **meaning in context**, its **family** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) and the words that usually go **with** it (collocations).

blocks.text: أسئلة الكتاب والمراجعات مش بتسألك «ترجم الكلمة» وخلاص. بتحطلك الكلمة **جوه جملة** وتسألك معناها **في السياق ده** (What does … mean in this context?)، أو تطلب منك **تغيّر شكل الكلمة** (noun / adjective / adverb)، أو تطلع **مرادف أو عكس** من قطعة. علشان كده ذاكر كل كلمة بالطريقة دي:

items: **اقرا المثال الأول** وافهم الكلمة من الجملة قبل ما تبص على الترجمة.
**احفظ المعنى الإنجليزي البسيط**، لأن الاختيارات في الـ MCQ بتيجي تعريفات بالإنجليزي.
**اعرف عيلة الكلمة**: الاسم والفعل والصفة والظرف.
**اعرف الكلمة بتيجي مع إيه** (collocation) زي gain experience مش make experience.
**اكتب جملة بنفسك** عن موضوع الوحدة بكل كلمة جديدة. الكتاب بيطلب كده في Practice: Write FOUR sentences using words from the text.

blocks.text: كلمات 8.1: Vocational Education in Egypt
التسجيل بيحكي عن **عمر** اللي اختار التعليم الفني بدل الطريق الأكاديمي التقليدي، وعن خطوات الدولة لدعم التعليم الفني.

items: vocational education
التعليم الفني / المهني · training for specific jobs and careers · مثال: **Vocational education** prepares students for real jobs.
practical skills
مهارات عملية · abilities used directly in real tasks · مثال: Employers look for strong **practical skills**.
hands-on experience
خبرة عملية (بإيدك) · learning by doing, not just theory · مثال: Students gain **hands-on experience** in workshops.
equip (with)
يجهّز / يزوّد بـ · to give someone the tools, skills or knowledge they need · مثال: The course **equips** students **with** modern skills.
workforce
القوى العاملة · all the people available for work · مثال: A skilled **workforce** helps the economy grow.
economic development
التنمية الاقتصادية · growth and improvement of a country's economy · مثال: Training supports Egypt's **economic development**.
unemployment
البطالة · the state of not having a job · مثال: Vocational schools can reduce **unemployment**.
labour market
سوق العمل · the jobs available and the people looking for them · مثال: The **labour market** needs technicians. (الكتاب بيكتبها labor بالأمريكي)
career pathway
مسار مهني · the steps that lead to a particular career · مثال: Engineering is one possible **career pathway**.
theoretical
نظري · based on ideas, not practice · مثال: Academic study is more **theoretical**.
graduate
خريج / يتخرج · a person who has finished a course of study · مثال: Employers hire **graduates** with real skills.

blocks.text: كلمات 8.2: Vocational Voices
خمس طلاب من مصر وإيطاليا والجزائر واليونان بيتكلموا في مؤتمر أونلاين عن تخصصاتهم الفنية.

items: agricultural vocational school
مدرسة زراعية فنية · a school that trains students in farming, crops and livestock · مثال: Ahmed studies at an **agricultural vocational school**.
irrigation system
نظام ري · a way of bringing water to crops · مثال: Modern **irrigation systems** save water.
livestock
الماشية / الثروة الحيوانية · farm animals such as cows and sheep · مثال: Desert projects raise **livestock**.
culinary arts
فنون الطهي · professional cooking and food preparation · مثال: Giulia studies **culinary arts** in Rome.
cybersecurity
الأمن السيبراني · protecting computer networks and digital systems · مثال: **Cybersecurity** experts stop cyberattacks.
hospitality management
إدارة الفنادق والضيافة · managing services for guests in hotels and tourism · مثال: Nadia studies **hospitality management**.
marine engineering
الهندسة البحرية · the study of ships and their systems · مثال: Greece needs experts in **marine engineering**.
in demand
مطلوب جدًا · wanted or needed by many people · مثال: Skilled engineers are always **in demand**.
sector
قطاع · one part of a country's economy · مثال: Tourism is a key **sector** in Egypt.
bridge the gap
يسدّ الفجوة · to connect two things that are far apart · مثال: This programme **bridges the gap** between school and work.
feasibility
إمكانية التنفيذ (الجدوى) · how possible and practical a plan is · مثال: Investors asked about the plan's **feasibility**.

blocks.text: وكمان الطلبة استخدموا **أمثال (proverbs)** مشهورة، احفظ معناها:

items.ar: التكرار بيعلّم الشطار: كل ما تتمرن أكتر تبقى أحسن (أحمد).

items.en: It's better to be safe than sorry.
items.ar: الوقاية خير من العلاج: احتاط أحسن ما تندم (يوسف عن الأمن السيبراني).

items.en: Smooth seas do not make skilful sailors.
items.ar: البحر الهادي مبيعملش بحّار شاطر: الصعوبات هي اللي بتقوّيك (ديميتري). (الكتاب بيكتبها skillful بالأمريكي) (الكتاب بيكتبها skillful بالأمريكي)

blocks.text: كلمات 8.3: The Egyptian-Japanese Schools (EJS)
النص عن المدارس المصرية اليابانية وأنشطة **التوكاتسو (Tokkatsu)** زي **وقت التنضيف (Soji)** اللي بتبني الشخصية جنب المذاكرة.

items: partnership
شراكة · a relationship where people work together to achieve a goal · مثال: EJS is the result of a **partnership** between Egypt and Japan.
collaborate
يتعاون · to work together to achieve a goal · مثال: Students **collaborate** to clean the classroom.
discipline
انضباط · controlling your behaviour and working responsibly · مثال: Success needs **discipline** and regular practice.
appreciation
تقدير / امتنان · gratitude or thanks · مثال: Soji teaches **appreciation** for all kinds of work.
relatively
نسبيًا · to a certain degree, not completely · مثال: Technical knowledge can be taught **relatively** quickly.
character development
بناء الشخصية · growing good personal qualities · مثال: EJS focuses on **character development**.
core values
القيم الأساسية · the most important beliefs and qualities · مثال: Respect and teamwork are **core values**.
cooperate
يتعاون · to work or act together · مثال: Employers want people who can **cooperate**.
interconnected
مترابط · connected with each other · مثال: The world is becoming more **interconnected**.
lifelong
مدى الحياة · lasting for your whole life · مثال: Good habits lead to **lifelong** success.
acquire (knowledge)
يكتسب · to get or learn something · مثال: Education is not only about **acquiring** knowledge.

blocks.text: كلمات 8.4: The Skills Employers Really Want
التسجيل بيقول إن الشهادة لوحدها مش كفاية: أصحاب الشغل عايزين **soft skills** كمان.

items: employability
القابلية للتوظيف · the skills needed to get and keep a job · مثال: Communication improves your **employability**.
adaptable
مرن (بيتأقلم) · able to adjust to new situations · مثال: Workers should be **adaptable** because jobs change.
academic qualifications
مؤهلات دراسية (شهادات) · certificates or degrees from courses or exams · مثال: **Academic qualifications** alone are not enough.
transition from school to work
الانتقال من الدراسة للشغل · moving from education to employment · مثال: Students need support during the **transition from school to work**.
soft skills
المهارات الشخصية · personal skills such as communication and teamwork · مثال: Employers value **soft skills** as much as technical skills.
technical skills
مهارات فنية (تقنية) · skills needed to do a specific job, like using tools · مثال: **Technical skills** help you get the job.
problem-solving
حل المشكلات · finding answers to difficult situations · مثال: **Problem-solving** is useful in every career.
teamwork
العمل الجماعي · working well with others in a group · مثال: Group projects build **teamwork**.
leadership
القيادة · the ability to guide a group · مثال: Class meetings develop **leadership**.
collaborative learning
التعلم التعاوني · learning by working together on a shared task · مثال: The Repair Circle used **collaborative learning**.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: Many questions ask for **the correct form of the word in brackets**. Learn the noun, verb, adjective and adverb together.

blocks.text: الجدول ده فيه أشهر عيلات الكلمات في الوحدة. خلي بالك من عيلة **employ** لأنها كبيرة ومهمة جدًا:

blocks.title: employer ولا employee؟
items: **employer** (-er) = صاحب الشغل اللي **بيوظّف**.
**employee** (-ee) = الموظف اللي **اتوظّف**. زي trainer (المدرب) و trainee (المتدرب).
**employment** = التوظيف / الشغل، **unemployment** = البطالة، **employability** = قابليتك إنك تتوظف.
في الإنجليزي البريطاني: **practice** اسم و **practise** فعل.

blocks.text: إزاي أعرف محتاج أنهي شكل من الكلمة؟

text: Look at the word **before** and **after** the gap. The position tells you if you need a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb.

blocks.text: في سؤال **Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets** بص على مكان الفراغ:
كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is a group of words that native speakers usually use together. Using them makes your writing sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني كلمتين «متجوزين»: لازم تستخدمهم مع بعض. احفظهم كده:

rows: Students **gain hands-on experience** in training centres.
Programmes must **meet the needs of** the labour market.
Training **bridges the gap** between school and work.
Graduates **enter the labour market** with confidence.
Workers must **take responsibility for** their actions.
Students learn to **work as a team** during Soji.

blocks.text: البادئات واللواحق (Prefixes & Suffixes)

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and often changes its meaning. A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the word class (noun, adjective…).

blocks.text: الـ **prefix** في **أول** الكلمة، والـ **suffix** في **آخرها**. الوحدة دي مليانة لواحق بتعمل أسماء أشخاص وصفات:
المرادفات والأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: Learn these pairs. Reviews ask for synonyms and antonyms in context.

blocks.text: فقرة بالكلمات الجديدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وركّز على الكلمات اللي بالـ bold. كلها من الوحدة:

text: When Hana finished preparatory school, she chose **vocational education** instead of the traditional academic route. At her technical school in Alexandria, she studies **marine engineering**, and she spends three days a week in a shipyard, where she **gains hands-on experience**. Her teachers say that **practical skills** are essential because skilled technicians are **in high demand** in the **labour market**.

Hana has also learned that **technical skills** are not enough. Her school has a **partnership** with a local company, and the **employers** there value **soft skills** such as **teamwork**, **discipline** and **problem-solving**. They want workers who are **adaptable** and can **collaborate** with others. Hana believes that this training will **equip** her **with** strong **employability** skills and make her **transition from school to work** much easier.

blocks.text: لاحظ: الفقرة فيها collocations زي **gains hands-on experience** و**in high demand** و**equip her with**، وفيها employer (الشخص) جنب employability (الاسم).

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ The employee hired ten workers. ← ✓ The **employer** hired ten workers. (اللي بيوظّف = employer)
✗ Communication improves your employment skills. ← ✓ Communication improves your **employability**.
✗ The course equips students to skills. ← ✓ The course equips students **with** skills.
✗ economical development ← ✓ **economic** development (economical = موفّر / مش بيصرف كتير)
✗ She has practice skills. ← ✓ She has **practical** skills. (قبل الاسم = صفة)
✗ make experience ← ✓ **gain** experience

blocks.title: حيلة سريعة للحفظ وللامتحان
items: اربط كل تخصص بالبلد: **agriculture** = أحمد (مصر)، **culinary arts** = جوليا (إيطاليا)، **cybersecurity** = يوسف (الجزائر)، **hospitality** = نادية (مصر)، **marine engineering** = ديميتري (اليونان).
**hard / technical skills** = حاجات بتتعلمها بسرعة (تستخدم عدة). **soft skills** = صفات بتاخد سنين (انضباط، تعاون، تواصل).
في سؤال **Complete the summary using words from the box** اقرا الجملة كلها الأول، وبعدين حدّد نوع الكلمة الناقصة (اسم ولا فعل ولا صفة) قبل ما تختار.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer: What does the word mean in this context?**

text: Laila takes a workshop on teamwork and learns to work with new people. These skills will make her more employable and improve her employability. What does "employability" mean in this context?
a. leaving school early   b. the money earned in one job   c. the ability to get and keep a suitable job   d. the study of technical subjects

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** الجملة بتقول إنه بيتعلم مهارات بتساعده في الشغل، يعني قدرته إنه يتوظف ويفضل في الشغل.
**2) Complete the summary using words from the box.**

text: Vocational education ________ students with the skills they need. A skilled ________ is essential for the economy.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: equips / workforce.** بعد Vocational education (فاعل مفرد) محتاجين فعل بـ s، وبعد skilled محتاجين اسم.
**3) Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

text: The project succeeded because of effective ________ (collaborate) among the students.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: collaboration.** بعد الصفة effective محتاجين **اسم**.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. All the people available for work in a country are called the ________.
a. workforce  b. workshop  c. partnership  d. sector

2. To be able to adjust successfully to new situations means you are ________.
a. economic  b. adaptable  c. ambitious  d. theoretical

3. Protecting computer networks from attacks is the main purpose of ________.
a. culinary arts  b. hospitality  c. cybersecurity  d. marine engineering

4. The vocational course was relatively short, but useful. "Relatively" means ________.
a. completely  b. to a certain degree  c. never  d. surprisingly
items.a: **b. to a certain degree** — نسبيًا، مش بشكل كامل.

items.q:
5. Students who work together to complete a shared project take part in ________ learning.
a. individual  b. unpaid  c. collaborative  d. temporary
items.a: **c. collaborative** — تعلم تعاوني (سؤال زي Review D).

items.q:
6. Through Soji, students show their ________ for the people who clean and maintain schools.
a. appreciation  b. unemployment  c. feasibility  d. livestock

7. Vocational education focuses on practical training. The opposite of "practical" is ________.
a. hands-on  b. technical  c. theoretical  d. useful

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 8. Communication and adaptability can increase a graduate's ________ (employ).
items.a: **employability** — قدرة الخريج إنه يتوظف (سؤال زي Review D).

items.q: 9. Many young people suffer from ________ (employ) because they lack practical skills.
10. Egypt is undertaking large ________ (agriculture) projects in desert areas.
11. Investing in industry supports the country's ________ (economy) development.
12. Employers prefer workers with good ________ (qualify).
13. The new programme is very ________ (innovate); it uses virtual reality in training.

blocks.text: **C. Find words in the text that are synonyms or antonyms of the words below.**

text: In the past, many young people thought that technical jobs were unwanted. Today, the situation is changing quickly. Skilled technicians are needed everywhere, and training centres are growing in number. Students learn to cooperate with others and to be flexible when tasks change. However, training is not always easy: it can be demanding.

items.q: 14. An antonym of "in demand"
15. A synonym of "rapidly"
16. A synonym of "collaborate"
17. A synonym of "adaptable"
18. A synonym of "challenging"
items.a: **demanding** — وعكسها easy اللي اتذكرت في نفس الجملة.

blocks.text: **D. Complete the sentences using words from the box.**

text: hands-on experience – partnership – discipline – transition from school to work – equips – soft skills

items.q: 19. Students gain valuable ________ when they practise tasks in workshops.
20. Vocational schools formed a ________ with local companies to train students.
21. Success in vocational education requires ________, regular practice and persistence.
22. Students need support during their ________.
23. The training centre ________ young people with the skills they need.
items.a: **equips** — فعل مفرد بعد The training centre، و equip ... with.

items.q: 24. Communication and teamwork are examples of ________.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: كلمات الوحدة بتدور حول: **التعليم الفني** (vocational education, hands-on experience, practical skills)، **التخصصات** (agricultural, culinary arts, cybersecurity, hospitality, marine engineering)، **التوكاتسو** (partnership, discipline, collaborate, appreciation) و**مهارات الشغل** (employability, adaptable, soft skills).
عيلة employ: **employer** (اللي بيوظّف) / **employee** (الموظف) / **employment** / **unemployment** / **employability**.
**economic** development مش economical. و **practical ↔ theoretical**.
Collocations: **gain** experience، **equip** someone **with**، **bridge** the gap، **in high demand**.
